agents.description: Locate narrow source owners and report verified paths; no edits or architecture decisions.
Resolve consequential method/design trade-offs; plan without implementation.
Read bounded sources and record evidence/counterevidence; use deep when synthesis needs it.
Create assigned artifacts from frozen brief/evidence; preserve other owners' edits.
Review raw artifacts in fresh context; use deep for public-contract/security risk.
Critique language-specific style without changing facts or replacing human taste.
